bins.response_description: Inverse-variance mean of the listed native measurements at their actual CWAVE/CBAND; response mixed, not a newly calibrated common bandpass.

bound.prior: Uniform in nonnegative true flux; zero for negative true flux
bound.likelihood: Gaussian fixed-position measurement with the reported conditional statistical error
bound.interpretation: Observed-data upper credible bound, not a detection-completeness limit or total-error bound.

sensitivity.interpretation: Conditional Gaussian fixed-position sensitivity. Quality-gate acceptance, source searching, varying variance and real-sky completeness are not included.

spectral_model.definition: Central native pixel in the official geometric 17-channel map; source PSF support may span a channel boundary.
spectral_model.fiducial_semantics: Laboratory representative channel centers/widths for labeling, not replacements for per-sample pipeline CWAVE/CBAND.
spectral_model.visualization_blank_semantics: Blank HiPS layers 50/51 do not prove the absence or validity of native measurements in those nominal channels.

interpretation: Time-combined descriptive summaries. Missing or unassigned measurements are not zeros or upper bounds. Original individual measurements remain authoritative.
scatter_interpretation: Equal-mean Gaussian chi-square is conditional on independent reported errors and a constant expectation. Differing spectral responses, variability or systematics can cause scatter. Warning uses family threshold 0.01 divided by tested bins; it is not a variability detection.
uncertainty_method: Independent native statistical variances propagated through fixed inverse-variance weights. Native correlations, common calibration, spectral-model and source-position systematics are not supplied.

source.name: Adjacent fixed sky position (no source identification)

credits: SPHEREx: NASA/JPL-Caltech/Caltech-IPAC, IRSA. Supplied source-position metadata and its interpretation remain separate from measured native fluxes.
